mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 51 degrees with clear skies at the Verona Public Library. Also, the International Space Station will be visible tonight for 3 minutes starting at 5:49 PM, appearing in the Northwest near Verona High School before heading toward the Northeast near Home Depot.

City buildings will be closed on November 26 and 27 for the Thanksgiving holiday. Additionally, the city is moving forward with a new Public Works and Utilities facility to better serve our growing population.
There is a great lineup of events including live music at Baileys Run Vineyard and Paddy Macs today, followed by performances at Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow.
Our local police department reports being busy over the last two weeks, including one case involving an O W I arrest that occurred between November 1 and November 15.
Today's flavor of the day is Crazy for Cookie Dough. Please note that the store opens today at 10:00 AM and will remain open until 10:30 PM.
